actual_scope: For every pair of integers of width 2 through 10, the base-B convolution digits of the FFT geometry carry back to the product, every carry stays at most q(B-1), and the final carry is zero.
scope_change_reason: The parameter package bounded the digit geometry. This package checks the carry map on that geometry. It does not run the word multiplier.
bottleneck_link: The carry map recovers the integer product, and the selected kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Record this recovery. Do not run the word multiplier.
evidence: All 1,398,096 products of width 2 through 10 satisfy the carry invariant. The worst-case update divides evenly by B.
